selector.rationale: Evidence of nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, admixed atypical lymphocytes, and clonal T-cell receptor rearrangements support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: No lymphadenopathy and lack of granulomatous inflammation

rejected.label: Rheumatoid arthritis
rejected.why: Arthritis symptoms relieved by prednisone, but presence of atypical lymphocytes and clonal T-cell receptor rearrangements suggests a lymphoproliferative disorder

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
rejected.why: Nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate and clonal T-cell receptor rearrangements are not typical of lymphomatoid papulosis

rejected.label: Pseudolymphoma
rejected.why: Presence of atypical lymphocytes and clonal T-cell receptor rearrangements suggests a true lymphoma rather than pseudolymphoma
